summary: Ray-sphere intersection test. Retrieves a 3D vector via TripleFieldGetter_2460, computes squared distance between that vector and the point a2, and returns 0 when the distance exceeds radius squared (a5*a5). When the distance is acceptable it copies a struct field array, calls an indirect D3D-device-wrapper routine, and rejects with 0 when the viewport depth result is not positive. Otherwise it clamps the hit position via ViewportPositionClamping, computes a delta through sub_5424E0, writes distance to a4 and position/delta to a3, and returns 1.
